position_overview:
Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant
- Patient Scheduling & Billing Support

Position type: Part-time | 20 hours per week
Location: Remote
- Philippines
Pay Rate: $5-$6 USD/hour
key_responsibilities:
1. Medical Billing Coordination & Tracking (Primary Focus)
- Monitor patient balances and outstanding accounts on a weekly or monthly basis.
- Track accounts receivable and follow up on unresolved billing concerns.
- Coordinate with external billing companies to help keep billing-related tasks on track.
- Flag outstanding issues that need attention.

Note: You will coordinate and track billing concerns, not process medical claims.

2. Patient Scheduling & Phone Support
- Answer incoming patient calls and assist with appointment inquiries.
- Schedule appointments and manage callbacks using Jane EHR.
- Communicate professionally and empathetically with patients.
- Handle approximately 5-10 inbound and 15-20 outbound calls per week, with potentially more outbound calls initially.

3. Patient Follow-Ups & Retention
- Follow up with existing patients regarding appointments and ongoing care.
- Encourage patients to schedule their next visit.
- Maintain organized patient follow-up lists and records.

Additional Administrative

- Contact interested patients from Facebook ads using a provided script and help schedule neuropathy program consultations.
- Prepare and send monthly newsletters through Mailchimp using provided content.
- Organize patient records, maintain trackers, and assist with other administrative tasks as needed.
- Previous experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Healthcare Administrative Assistant, or Patient Coordinator.
- Experience with patient scheduling, inbound/outbound calls, or patient follow-ups.
- Basic understanding of medical billing terminology, patient balances, and accounts receivable.
- Strong English communication skills, particularly when speaking with patients over the phone.
- Comfortable using EHR/EMR systems or similar healthcare software.
- Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups.
- Proactive, dependable, and comfortable working independently.
- Willing and able to work the required 20-hour weekly schedule without overlapping commitments to other clients.
- HIPAA-trained and knowledgeable about patient confidentiality.

Nice to Have
- Familiarity with billing coordination or tracking outstanding patient balances.
- Experience with Jane EHR or similar systems.
- Familiarity with Mailchimp or newsletter management.
- Experience supporting chiropractic, rehabilitation, or other healthcare practices.

Basic Requirements
- Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
- Must have relevant work experience.
- Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
- Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements
- Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
- Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
- Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
- Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
- Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.
- Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
- Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
- HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
- Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
- Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client's needs and schedule.
- Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
- Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
- Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.
